title: Register the new Epopeja character-sheet app in the shared icon family and the phone focus-mode whitelist
objective: ~/epopeja_karta is a new Flutter app, ported out of a claude.ai session, that still shipped the stock Flutter 'beach' launcher icon -- which per CLAUDE.md means it is not done. It also carries a com.kuhy.* package id, and phone_focus_mode disables any com.kuhy.* package not on its whitelist within about a second at home, so an install would appear to work and then close instantly. Give the app a family icon generated by the shared generator (never a hand-rolled one-off) and add it to the whitelist. Success: `generate --app epopeja_karta --android` writes mipmaps showing the app's own glyph, the glyph is distinguishable from the other eight at 48dp, and the package id is present in config.sh ready for the next deploy.
acceptance_criteria: The glyph is registered in python_pkg/app_icons/glyphs.py and the app in python_pkg/app_icons/apps.py -- no per-repo copy of the generator and no hand-drawn icon anywhere in ~/epopeja_karta
The accent is the shared family accent #B8862E, not an app-specific colour: apps in this family are distinguished by glyph shape only, as apps.py's own docstring requires
The glyph reads as what it depicts at launcher size and collides with nothing already in the family; the first draft rendered as a map pin and was rejected on exactly that ground
Geometry is inside the family budget: safe_box_overflow returns (0, 0), and every gap between filled regions is at or above MIN_NEGATIVE_SPACE (36px), so nothing merges into a blob at 48dp
The vent hole and slit are true holes via fill-rule=evenodd, because icon_foreground and icon_monochrome render on transparency where a painted hole shows as a blob and in the wrong colour
python_pkg/app_icons keeps 100% branch coverage with zero suppressions, and pre-commit passes on every changed file except hooks failing for pre-existing repo-wide reasons
com.kuhy.epopeja_karta appears in the WHITELIST block of phone_focus_mode/config.sh alongside the other com.kuhy.* productive apps
out_of_scope: The app itself -- lib/, tests, CI and the Android package rename all live in ~/epopeja_karta, a separate repo, and are not part of this commit
Deploying the whitelist to the phone -- deploy.sh needs the device, which is intentionally not being used this session; config.sh and the device stay out of sync until then
A Linux hicolor icon set or .desktop entry -- the app has a linux/ target purely so it can be driven on the desktop during development, so linux=False
Any change to the shared accent or to another app's glyph
verifier: PYTHONPATH=~/testsAndMisc python3 -m python_pkg.app_icons list (shows epopeja_karta -> quill-nib #B8862E); preview -o sheet.png and eyeball the nib against the other eight glyphs at all three sizes; python3 -c "...render.safe_box_overflow(glyphs.get_glyph('quill-nib'), '#B8862E')" returns (0, 0); generate --app epopeja_karta --android then view android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-xxxhdpi/ic_launcher.png; python3 -m coverage run --branch --source=python_pkg/app_icons -m pytest python_pkg/app_icons/tests then coverage report (100%); pre-commit run --files python_pkg/app_icons/glyphs.py python_pkg/app_icons/apps.py phone_focus_mode/config.sh
